text: はー　はー　６のしまの　みなと　から　いっきに　およいで　きたぜ…！

structure.jp: ６のしまの　みなと　から
いっきに　およいで　きたぜ…！
structure.en: I swam here in one go...!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb followed by くる says the action ends up here, where the speaker is. およいで　きた = 'I swam here'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy stress on what you say. きたぜ = 'I came, man'.
